title: geranium libanoticum
intro: Geranium libanoticum, commonly known as the Lebanese geranium, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the family Geraniaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving stress and anxiety, and promoting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Geranium libanoticum include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its overall therapeutic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include geraniol, linalool, and other flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
